correctness.rationale: For each vertex in part V_i, the avoided closed-neighborhood complement is V_i minus that vertex. Pair intersections have size n_i-2 only for same-part pairs and are empty for cross-part pairs when k>=1. A spanning tree can attain exactly n_i-1 same-part edges in every part simultaneously, proving the tau_k formula. Non-dominating k-sets are exactly proper k-subsets of a single part. The per-part binomial identity gives the residual, which is nonnegative and vanishes exactly at n_i<=k+1. The included direct-definition verifier checks every complete-multipartite isomorphism type through order 11.

value.rationale: The 2026 source introduces the spanning-tree overlap correction precisely to exploit highly overlapping neighborhoods and explicitly asks for higher-order corrections. Complete multipartite graphs are a canonical dense family with strongly repeated open-neighborhood structure and highly overlapping avoidance events. The finding determines the new optimization parameter, gives an exact sharpness boundary, and quantifies the entire omitted higher-order contribution. That makes it a motivated structural calibration of the new method rather than a routine recomputation of a known domination polynomial.
